## 

```{r}

library(readr)
lizard <- read_csv("lizard.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1"))
View(lizard)

library(dplyr)

lizard <- data.frame(lizard)

# Exclude what we do not want
lizardclean <- lizard %>% select(-Average.Female.adult.weight..g.,-RCM,-SD.Female.adult.weight..g.,-Sample.Size.Female.adult.weight,-Sample.size.Mean.F.SVL.adults,-Clutches.per.year,-Sample.size.Clutch.Size.,-Offspring.SVL..mm.,-SD.F.SVL.adults..mm.)



```

Lets check for how many NAs there are to be able to know what data we can use



```{r}
na_summary <- data.frame(
  column = names(lizard),
  n_NA = colSums(is.na(lizard)),
  proportion_NA = colMeans(is.na(lizard)),
  percentage_NA = colMeans(is.na(lizard)) * 100
)

print(na_summary)

library(ggplot2)

na_summary <- data.frame(
  column = names(lizard),
  proportion_NA = colMeans(is.na(lizard))
)

ggplot(na_summary, aes(x = reorder(column, proportion_NA),
                       y = proportion_NA)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of missing values per variable",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "Proportion of NAs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  
```

```{r}

lizard_numeric <- lizard[, sapply(lizard, is.numeric)]

cor_matrix <- cor(lizard_numeric,
                  use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
                  method = "pearson")

round(cor_matrix, 2)

library(corrplot)

corrplot(cor_matrix,
         method = "color",
         type = "upper",
         order = "hclust",
         addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.srt = 45,
         tl.cex = 0.6,
         number.cex = 0.5,
         diag = FALSE)
```

I want to try out some linear models ( why? bcs i know them and like them))



```{r}

lm.svl.clutch <- lm(formula = `Mean Clutch Size` ~ `Mean F SVL adults (mm)`,data = lizard)

#Plot data points
plot(lizard$`Mean F SVL adults (mm)`,
     lizard$`Mean Clutch Size`,
     xlab = "Mean F SVL (mm)",
     ylab = "Mean Clutch Size",
     pch = 20)
#lm line 
abline(lm.svl.clutch,lwd=2,col="blue")

summary(lm.svl.clutch)

###trying another format  distribution
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(lizard, aes(x = `Mean F SVL adults (mm)`, y = `Mean Clutch Size`, color = Distribution)) +
  geom_point() +  # Scatter plot points colored by Distribution
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +  # Linear regression line
  labs(title = "Mean Clutch Size vs Mean SVL Adults by Distribution",
       x = "Mean F SVL adults (mm)",
       y = "Mean Clutch Size") +
  theme_minimal()


###trying another format reproduction
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(lizard, aes(x = `Mean F SVL adults (mm)`, y = `Mean Clutch Size`, color =`Mode of reproduction` )) +
  geom_point() +  # Scatter plot points colored by Distribution
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +  # Linear regression line
  labs(title = "Mean Clutch Size vs Mean SVL Adults by Mode of reproduction",
       x = "Mean F SVL adults (mm)",
       y = "Mean Clutch Size") +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
lm.weight.lenght <- lm(formula = `Average Female adult weight (g)` ~ `Mean F SVL adults (mm)`,data = lizard)

plot(lizard$`Mean F SVL adults (mm)`,

#lm line 
abline(lm.weight.lenght,lwd=2,col="blue")

summary(lm.svl.clutch)
```

next some anova obs 


```{r}
anova.clutch <- aov(`Mean Clutch Size` ~ Distribution, data = lizard)

summary(anova.clutch)

boxplot(`Mean Clutch Size` ~ Distribution, data = lizard)





anova.SVL <- aov(`Mean F SVL adults (mm)` ~ Distribution, data = lizard)

summary(anova.SVL)

boxplot(`Mean F SVL adults (mm)` ~ Distribution, data = lizard)






anova.clutch <- aov(`Mean Clutch Size` ~ `Mode of reproduction`, data = lizard)

summary(anova.clutch)

boxplot(`Mean Clutch Size` ~ `Mode of reproduction`, data = lizard)





anova.SVL <- aov(`Mean F SVL adults (mm)` ~ `Mode of reproduction`, data = lizard)
                 
summary(anova.SVL)

boxplot(`Mean F SVL adults (mm)` ~ `Mode of reproduction`, data = lizard)

```
